raw_response:

The current ratio of 1.71 suggests good short-term liquidity, and a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 1.10 (89,800M/81,292M) is manageable. These financial metrics, particularly the high margins and decent liquidity, point towards a solid credit profile.

DECISION: A+
